home.description: I observe the world, uncover meaningful problems, and turn insights into thoughtful design that creates positive change.

about.paragraph1: I’m a UX/UI designer and product thinker who enjoys exploring the relationship between people, technology, and the world around us.
about.paragraph2: I approach design by observing real experiences, uncovering meaningful problems, and turning complex ideas into clear, thoughtful digital experiences.
about.paragraph3: Beyond interfaces, I’m interested in the bigger picture: how products create value, how people connect, and how design can make a positive difference.
